messages:
Emma (Support): FYI from a customer (Acme): sudden 504s for bulk /embeddings requests starting ~09:10 UTC, p95 latency jumps then timeouts.
Raj (SRE): can you paste the request shape and sample headers? rate, batch size, region?
Emma (Support): request via SDK v0.18.1, JS. batch=64, embeddings endpoint, region=us-west-2, concurrent clients ~12. Auth via long-lived token. Customer says SDK retries backoff made more requests but still saw wave of 504s.
Zoe (Solutions): @Emma any customer id/tenant so we can look at routing and tenant capacity?
Emma (Support): tenant: acme-inc-3421. I have their truncated logs:
```
2026-03-10T09:09:58Z request_id=abcd1234 method=POST path=/v1/embeddings status=200 duration_ms=112
2026-03-10T09:10:12Z request_id=abcd1235 method=POST path=/v1/embeddings status=504 duration_ms=30007 upstream_error=timeout
2026-03-10T09:10:12Z request_id=abcd1236 method=POST path=/v1/embeddings status=504 duration_ms=30010 upstream_error=connection_reset
2026-03-10T09:10:13Z request_id=abcd1237 method=POST path=/v1/embeddings status=200 duration_ms=130
```
Emma (Support): They sent ~120 requests in 30s window at batch=64.
Lin (Eng): that pattern looks like short-lived queue saturation on the embedding pools — some requests hit a longer path (fallback model variant). Are these hitting cross-tenant noisy neighbor throttles?
Raj (SRE): I ran a quick query for that tenant around ts 1766541000-1766544000: saw a sharp spike in inflight per-gpu and transient enqueue depth on pool-embeds-usw2-01.
Raj (SRE): attaching snippet from observability:
```
metric:embedding_inflight_gpu_count{pool="embeds-usw2-01"}  -> spike 4x
metric:pool_enqueue_ms{pool="embeds-usw2-01"}  -> 95th ~ 24000ms
```
Zoe (Solutions): customer is on Shared tier with soft concurrency limits. SDK retries probably amplified the wave. We should confirm if circuit-breaker configured. Emma, did they use default retry policy?
Emma (Support): they used default SDK RetryStrategy.exp_backoff (no jitter).
Lin (Eng): that could cause synchronized retry bursts. Two actions: (1) short-term mitigation: ask customer to reduce concurrency or set client-side maxRetries=2 and add jitter. (2) platform fix: add jitter to default retry policy in SDK and consider token-based routing to spread tenant across pools.
Emma (Support): I sent a quick mitigation note to customer: reduce concurrency to 4 and enable jitter on retries. They said they can do that but want platform-side protection.
Raj (SRE): I'll temporarily raise per-tenant enqueued limit for acme-inc-3421 on embeds-usw2-01 to avoid hard 504s while we investigate. Patching now.
infra-bot: change_request: update-tenant-throttle acme-inc-3421 pool=embeds-usw2-01 new_max_inflight=24 by=raj at=2026-03-10T09:36:20Z
Raj (SRE): patched. Monitoring for the next 10m.
Lin (Eng): Also seeing a small increase in tail latency for the quantized variant when sequence_len > 1024 — that can hit fallback slower CPU path. Can we get a sample payload size?
Emma (Support): customer payload sizes: avg tokens per item ~ 150, worst-case ~ 2k on a handful of requests.
Lin (Eng): there's the culprit. Large sequence items force fallback. Suggest they shard large inputs or send those as separate smaller batches. We'll also add an autoscaler rule to detect sudden queue growth and spawn extra embed workers quicker.
Zoe (Solutions): I'll coordinate a postmortem and a customer-facing note explaining root cause and short-term mitigations.
Emma (Support): customer update sent: "We saw transient congestion on the embeddings pool due to a burst of large batched requests and synchronized SDK retries. We've applied a temporary uplift to your tenant limit and recommended SDK config changes. Engineering is rolling platform mitigations." They replied :+1: and asked for ETA on platform changes.
Lin (Eng): ETA for SDK default jitter change: small PR today, release next deploy (approx 48h). Autoscaler tweak: requires testing, ETA ~5 business days. Longer term: tenant-aware routing is a design item, 3-4 sprints.
Raj (SRE): monitor update: after patch, enqueue depth down to baseline, 504s stopped for the tenant. I'll keep watch for 1 hour.
Emma (Support): marking this thread as customer-in-contact. Will follow up with postmortem once Zoe has draft.
Zoe (Solutions): draft PM to customer will include repro steps, suggested SDK config sample, and timeline. Working on wording.
Emma (Support): sample SDK snippet I sent:
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ token: process.env.RW_TOKEN });
await client.setRetryOptions({ maxRetries: 2, backoff: 'exponential', jitter: true, maxConcurrency: 4 });
```
Emma (Support): closing notes: temporary tenant uplift id=CR-1029, follow-up PM due EOD tomorrow.
Raj (SRE): note for ops: look for similar patterns from other tenants w/ large payloads + default retry settings, we may need a bulk-mitigation playbook.
Lin (Eng): added task ENG-5021 to backlog (autoscaler + fallback detection).
Zoe (Solutions): thanks all — will post customer-facing summary after review.
Emma (Support): thanks team, will update thread when customer acknowledges PM.
